To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CD4+ and γδT cell populations in MAP-infected cows have a more activated phenotype after stimulation with MAP, but CD8+ T cell activation is not increased.
T and B cells from cows with JD are activated by MAP stimulation.
the activation of CD4+CD25+ T cells, CD4+CD28- T cells and CD4+CD8- γδ+ T cells in JD+ cows is increased compared to JD- cows after in vitro MAP stimulation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of the immune response of dairy cattle to MAP.
the characterization of immune responses against the MAP in JD test positive cows, with the goal of identifying immune markers that can be used to diagnose JD.
the characterization of the T and B cell activation profile of dairy cows with and without JD in response to stimulation with MAP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

MAP stimulation of PBMC from JD test positive cattle resulted in a greater activation of CD4+CD25+, γδ+CD25+, and SIgM+B25+ cells, while MAP stimulation of PB cells from JD test negative cattle did not result in increased activation of these cells.
the T and B cell activation profile of JD test positive cows is different from that of JD test negative cows in response to in-vitro stimulation with MAP.

the activation profiles of CD4+, γδ+ and B cells from JD+ cows were significantly altered compared to those from JD- cows, while the activation profile of CD8+ T lymphocytes was not significantly altered.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MAP stimulation of peripheral blood mononucelar cells from JD+ and JD- cattle results in differential activation profiles for T and B cell subpopulations.
MAP stimulates the expression of CD25 on a subset of T and B cells from JD+ animals but not from JD- animals.
MAP-specific T and B cells from JD+ cows are more activated than those from JD test negative cows, which could contribute to the chronicity of JD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activation profile of T and B cells from JD+ cows in response to MAP stimulation is distinct from that of T cells and B cells from cows that are MAP-free.
JD+ cows have a more robust immune response to MAP compared to JD test negative cows.
the immune response against MAP is not uniform in JD+ cows and that the immune response to MAP is more diverse in JD+ than JD test negative cows.
